facts.text: John's favorite basketball team is the Wolves, and his favorite player is LeBron.

evidence.quote: The Wolves are my team for sure. And LeBron is the man - love his skills and leadership.
The Wolves are solid and LeBron's skills and leadership are amazing.

facts.text: John admires LeBron's work ethic and dedication to the game.

evidence.quote: I really admire his work ethic and dedication to the game, such an inspiration.

facts.text: John has met LeBron a few times and has seen him play live.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I've had the chance to meet him a few times. He's real chill and it was a wild experience. I also had the opportunity to see him play live.
